name: Old town of Regensburg with Stadtamhof
description: Regensburg sits where the Naab and Regen rivers meet the Danube in eastern Bavaria. Its medieval centre is a maze of dark, narrow lanes lined with tall patrician houses, towers and churches, some dating back to Roman times. Walk across the 12th-century Old Bridge to Stadtamhof, then admire the Gothic cathedral and the city hall where emperors once held assemblies.
